desc:
The Eggs drifting down the rushing river! Go Break Them Before They Are Lost! 
What Are You Waiting For Join The Game And Check It Out!

1. Break the Eggs floating down the river! ⛏️
2. Collect animals From The Eggs! 
3. Bring them back to your Pen! 🏡
4. Your pets collect cash so you can UPGRADE TO BETTER PICKAXES! 💵⚡

Will you Unlock all the animals? 🔓
💸 YOUR PETS GENERATE CASH TO HELP YOU UPGRADE! 💸

LIKE the game and join the GROUP for special rewards! 👍
